content.question: Which statement about the GPT architecture is correct?
options: It is encoder-only with bidirectional attention
It is decoder-only: a stack of Transformer blocks with masked self-attention and no encoder or cross-attention
It is an encoder-decoder with cross-attention between them
It is a recurrent network with LSTM cells
content.answer: It is decoder-only: a stack of Transformer blocks with masked self-attention and no encoder or cross-attention
